title: cullen biflorum

It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Cullen biflorum are responsible for its medicinal properties, and further research is needed to fully understand its potential therapeutic applications.
